title: Costs rebuild 2 · piece 4b: the cost read loads its request records (loading becomes part of the read)
description:
**Split from LIN-4201 (scope decision item 2, LIN-4201 review of PR #2273).** Parent: LIN-4195. Follows LIN-4201's merge.

**What.** The cost read takes its request records from a cost source, the one request-usage loader (`lib/request-usage-loader.js`), instead of a `requestRows` array each caller loads for itself. `readCost`, `lineageRecords`, `lineageFigureOf` and `buildRunView` load through the source; no caller calls `forAnchors` or `forRows` for a figure.

**Why split.** LIN-4201 already requires `requestRows` on every entry point and wires seven production callers to the loader. Moving the load inside the read changes those entry points to async and touches nine callers, the `/kpis` batching (one instance-wide `forRows` call today) and the replay harness. It needs its own proof, so it lands separately. LIN-4201 keeps the required argument, so this piece changes only the input's shape.

**Callers in scope** (as listed in LIN-4201's review): `routes/proxy-compute.js` (`/cost`), `lib/model-routing-history.js`, `routes/dashboard-effort.js`, `lib/kpi-stats.js`, `lib/workspace-kpi-stats.js`, `routes/dashboard.js` (run page), `lib/run-paragraph-hook.js`.

**Constraints.**

* `/kpis` keeps one batched instance-wide load. Moving the load into the read must not turn it into per-lineage queries.
* The read stays pure over whatever source it is given; tests inject a fake source.
* The replay diff still equals `tests/fixtures/cost-replay/lin4201-change-list.json` exactly, and the replay feeds the records through the source.

**Acceptance.** Every production caller passes the source, none loads for itself (`grep -rn "forAnchors\|forRows" routes lib` finds only the loader and the read's own entry); a mutation that bypasses the source turns a test red; the full unit suite and the cost-page E2E specs stay green.

## Implementation Plan

*Pruned at close-out. The plan (sections 1-8: the problem, direction, decisions, inventory, landing order, witnesses, risks, and the LIN-4203 collision note) and its revisions were implemented as approved. The full pre-prune description is preserved in the task snapshots, and the history is in the comment trail.*

**Implemented:** PR [https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2275](<https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2275>), squash-merged as `c55f0fb3`. Deviations from the plan, all accepted at review: a both-`urlKey`-and-`instanceWide` guard; the `requestRows` census counts identifiers only; the effort route's records load starts when the read runs (identity and records still load in parallel inside the read). Review's close-out fixes landed in `56435e70`.

Session fit: fits one session

plan-review due: yes

## LIN-4226 planning, beat 1/4: grounding (no code changed)

**HEAD:** `2ee4e600` (LIN-4201's squash merge, 16:34Z), the same as `origin/main`. The only commit since this ticket was filed (13:07Z) on any in-scope path is `2ee4e600` itself. It is the baseline this ticket follows, and its content equals the `7a9ca445`/`a878966c` head the description was written against. Nothing has drifted.

**The open questions, answered from the code**
1. **Is `buildRunView` a production caller? Yes, it has two.** `routes/dashboard.js:694-696` (the run page's `loadRunLocal`) and `lib/run-paragraph-hook.js:83-85` (the paragraph precompute) each call `forAnchors(urlKey, runLineageAnchors(session))` and then pass `requestRows` in. `lib/render-session.js:495` builds the view only when `runView` is not passed; that happens in unit tests, never on the route. `lineageFigureOf` has one production caller, `lib/run-view.js:271`, inside `buildRunView`.
2. **Does the replay already route records through the source? Only partly.** `tests/fixtures/cost-replay/harness.js:298` builds `loaderOver(...)` / `NO_REQUEST_RECORDS`. S1 (the `/cost` route), S5/S6/S8/S9 (`readModelsHistory`) and S12 (`collectWorkspaceKpis`) take the loader. S10 (:352 `forAnchors`), S11 (:374 `forRows`) and S13 (:381 `forAnchors`) load in the harness itself, playing the caller's part. Those three need rewiring.
3. **Contract gaps.**
   - The acceptance grep (`routes lib`) misses `server.js:2506`, where `/kpis` is wired as `requestRows: rows => requestUsageLoader.forRows(rows)`.
   - The Models read has two more production callers than the listed seven: `routes/settings.js:295` and `routes/dispatch.js:689`, both through `readModelsHistory`.
   - These scripts pass `requestRows` and break on a shape change: `scripts/lin-4200-measure-records-vs-snapshots.mjs:557-559` (deliberately `[]`), `scripts/lin3014/capture-kpis.mjs:65` and `scripts/lin-4200-d13-volume-timing.mjs:300`. The only "no records" source today is the test fixture `NO_REQUEST_RECORDS` in `tests/fixtures/request-usage-loader.js`.
   - The LIN-4201 required-argument throw has to survive under the new shape.
   - Sibling LIN-4203 is now In Progress. It runs mostly in the runner, but it reads the `/kpis` harness shares (`lib/terminal-marked-task-cost.js`), so the two may touch the same file.

## LIN-4226: implementation plan written

The plan is in this ticket's description, under `## Implementation Plan`, appended below the original sections, which are unchanged. It is grounded at Harbour `2ee4e600`, with every line number re-checked there.

**In short:**
- The read takes `{ requestSource, urlKey }` and loads once at each entry (`readCost`, `lineageRecords`, `buildRunView`). A missing source, or the old `requestRows`, throws.
- The summarisers downstream take the read's output, never records.
- `/kpis` keeps its one `forRows` load. `NO_REQUEST_RECORDS` moves into lib.

**Departures from the ticket's wording, with reasons in the plan:**
- `lineageFigureOf` becomes the pure per-lineage core inside `buildRunView`, so the run page makes one load rather than one per lineage.
- The acceptance grep misses `server.js:2506`, so the census scans `server.js`, `scripts` and the replay harness too.
- Settings and dispatch Models callers, and three scripts, are added beyond the listed seven.

**What else is in it:** 7 witnesses, each failing at `2ee4e600` (two of them try the bypass the guard stops); a fallback split, 4b-i / 4b-ii; how to land beside LIN-4203.

Session fit: one session. **Plan review is due:** this changes the read's required-argument contract and rewrites the census guard.

## LIN-4226: plan self-review (beat 4/4), and what changed

I re-read the plan as a builder starting fresh and checked it against source at `2ee4e600`. The block was replaced in place; the original sections are unchanged.

**Changed, and why**
1. **The `urlKey` rule no longer depends on the data.** The plan threw when a row had no `urlKey` and the call gave none, but `/kpis` makes exactly that call. Its rows do carry `urlKey` (the history projection, `lib/kpi-stats.js:453`, and the raw queue docs, `:630`). Today, though, a row without it is skipped (`lib/request-usage-loader.js:61-70`, `lineageIdentityOfRows` at `lib/dispatch-store.js:337`), so one legacy row would have failed the public page. **Now:** the read needs `urlKey` or an explicit `instanceWide: true`, which only `/kpis` passes, and it throws when it has neither. Under `instanceWide`, a row with no `urlKey` is skipped, as it is today.
2. **One load per module, stated outright.** `readCost` awaits `lineageRecords` (as at `:360`) and doesn't load itself, so a call makes one load, not two. That leaves exactly one `.forRows(` in `lib/cost-read.js` and one `.forAnchors(` in `lib/run-view.js`, both in entries the ticket names. The census pins those counts. This is consistent with "only the loader and the read's own entry path".
3. **The Models consumer list is complete.** Two consumers of `readModelsHistory`'s old `identityRows`/`requestRows` were missing:
   - the `safeRead` fallback default at `routes/settings.js:295`;
   - the shape pin at `tests/unit/model-routing-history.test.js:52`.

   The plan also now gives the reason the output is identical: every call is `readCost` over the same inputs, and the summarisers only filter.
4. **Session fit is decided, and the fallback split is dropped.** I could not name anything one session would lose track of. The required-source throw and the census turn every missed caller into a failing test, and the 44 wrapper files are one-line swaps. A split would only add a temporary census exception that someone has to remember to remove.
5. **Two witnesses added:**
   - witness 8: an `identityRows` promise proves the identity and records queries stay parallel;
   - witness 9: Models reads once, and the replay's S5, S6, S8 and S9 stay identical.

   Witness 2 gains the `renderSessionPage` without `runView` throw and the skip of rows without `urlKey` under `instanceWide`.

**Unchanged:** decisions (c)–(e), the inventory, the LIN-4203 interaction, and plan-review due (this changes the read's contract and its guard).

## Autopilot (stepper) run summary: LIN-4226 plan

Kind: `plan` only, stepped as 4 beats in one warm worker session (ROOT dispatch `666b718a-e253-4ac9-b4f4-ecec86bae800`). No code was changed, so there is no PR, test run or CI run for this step.

**Beats**
1. **Grounding** (`666b718a`): set In Progress, re-grounded against HEAD `2ee4e600` (no drift since the ticket was filed), answered the three open questions with file:line. Comment `e7b93b1b`.
2. **Inventory and design** (`8948e9ed`): repeatable search, in/out place list, decisions (a)-(e), witnesses, likeliest breaks.
3. **Plan written** (`25d93cd0`): `## Implementation Plan` appended to the description; two beat-2 counts corrected on re-check (44 wrapper files, ~28 effort-readout awaits). Comment `e30c2c3d`.
4. **Builder's-eye challenge** (`0bf612c8`): fixed a data-dependent `urlKey` throw (now `urlKey` or explicit `instanceWide`, only `/kpis` passes it), stated one load per entry, completed the Models consumer list, committed to `fits one session` (fallback split dropped, reason written down), added witnesses 8-9. Comment `23599800`.

**Verified by me in Linear after beats 3 and 4:** one `## Implementation Plan` heading; `fits one session` once, `needs multiple sessions` never; one `plan-review due: yes` line; the original description sections intact; issue state In Progress.

**What holds:** a plan with the problem and done-when, direction with alternatives set aside, the full place inventory with repeatable commands, seven-plus witnesses that fail at HEAD, the three likeliest breaks, and how to land beside LIN-4203.

**What is left / for the human edge:** `plan-review due: yes` because the plan changes the read's contract and its census guard. It also departs from the ticket's wording on `lineageFigureOf` (it becomes the pure core inside `buildRunView` rather than a loading entry) and widens scope to Settings/dispatch Models callers, `server.js` `/kpis` wiring and three scripts. A plan-review step should confirm those before implementation.

### Plan Review Verdict
**Verdict:** Approve. The premise holds at HEAD: the read can load its own records with one load per entry, `/kpis` stays one batched load, and no production caller is missing. The notes below are corrections the plan's own witnesses would surface; none changes its shape.

**What I checked (LinearViewer `main` = `origin/main` = `2ee4e600`)**
- **Staleness.** `git log --since=2026-11-04T13:07:42Z` over every path the plan names finds only `2ee4e600`, the plan's own baseline. Nothing has drifted since the plan was written.
- **Premises, read at HEAD.**
  - The loader is a frozen `{forAnchors, forRows}` (`lib/request-usage-loader.js:46,80`).
  - `forRows` batches by workspace (`:61-77`), 500 anchors per call (`:28,55`).
  - Empty anchors return `[]` with no query (`:53`).
  - The entry line numbers in `lib/cost-read.js` are as stated (`:130,138,279,350,360,481`).
  - `lineageFigureOf` is already pure and synchronous; its one production caller is `lib/run-view.js:271`.
  - The replay harness loads for itself at S10/S11/S13 (`tests/fixtures/cost-replay/harness.js:352,374,381`).
  - `/kpis` makes one `forRows` (`server.js:2506`, `lib/kpi-stats.js:1085`), over rows that carry `urlKey` (`:451`).
  - `lib/kpi-stats.js:1083` and `lib/terminal-marked-task-cost.js:145` group the same rows into lineages.
  - The counts hold: 44 files with 56 `withRequestRows` lines, and 27 + 1 effort-readout call sites.
- **Loading over `fetchedRows` matches what callers load today.**
  - `/cost` loads `anchorsOfRows(fetchedRows)` today.
  - **Effort read-out:** `normalizeDispatchRow` returns `{...row}` spreads (`lib/effort-readout.js:138,152`), so `anchorOf` is unchanged. `fetchedRows` (`:443`) holds every lineage `selectAnchors` keeps (`:446`).
  - **Scoped reads:** formatted history rows carry no `urlKey` (`_formatHistoryItem`, `lib/dispatch-store.js:2961-3038`). Formatted queue rows nest it as `workspace.urlKey` (`:3972`). So `forRows` uses the `urlKey` passed in, as the plan requires.
- **Caller search.** I searched `lib routes server.js scripts` (excluding `scripts/eval/**`) for every call of `readCost|lineageRecords|lineageFigureOf|buildRunView|buildView|collectKpiStats|collectWorkspaceKpis|readModelsHistory|agentSpendByJob|typicalByModel|computeEffortReadout|computeWorkspaceEffortReadout|computeTerminalMarkedTaskCost|createRunParagraphPrecompute`. I also searched for imports of the folds that take records (`lineageUsageOf|foldRequestUsage|lineageFigure|oneRecordPerRequest`) outside their own module.
  - Every hit is in the plan's list, or already takes the loader: `routes/workspace-kpis.js:29`, `scripts/lin-4200-d13-volume-timing.mjs:301`, `server.js:584`.
  - The only fold imported elsewhere is `lineageFigure`, which takes the read's output. **No production caller is missing.**
- **`renderSessionPage`'s 404 calls** (`routes/dashboard.js:349,357`) return at the `!session` branch, before the fallback at `lib/render-session.js:495`. Requiring `runView` doesn't affect them.

**Notes for the builder (non-blocking)**
1. **Is `lineageFigureOf` a pure core or not?** The plan lists `lineageFigureOverRecords` among the pure cores no other production module may import. It also says `lineageFigureOf` becomes that core inside `buildRunView`. But `lib/run-view.js:30` imports `lineageFigureOf` from `./cost-read.js`, so the census would flag it.
   - `REQUIRED_ARG` also lists `lineageFigureOf` (`tests/unit/lin-4201-cost-callers.test.js:177`). A "must carry `requestSource`" rule would flag `run-view.js:271` as well.
   - **Do:** keep `lineageFigureOf(rows, { records })` as the synchronous per-lineage figure. Keep it outside the `*OverRecords` family and drop it from `REQUIRED_ARG`. Or allow-list `lib/run-view.js` for that one import, by name. The behaviour is the same either way: one load per run page, sliced per lineage.
2. **Use the right argument name per function in the census.**
   - `REQUIRED_ARG` already maps `collectWorkspaceKpis` and `readModelsHistory` to `requestUsageLoader`, and `readModelsHistory` takes the loader positionally.
   - `REQUIRED_DEP` (`:186-194`) keys all seven route factories on `requestUsageLoader`.
   - Written literally, witness 3's "a call without `requestSource`" fails on unchanged, correct callers such as `routes/workspace-kpis.js:29`.
   - **Do:** set each entry's name in the table (`requestSource` for the read entries and `collectKpiStats`; `requestUsageLoader` where the dep is injected), or rename consistently everywhere.
3. **Fix the scripts' call shapes, and exercise the measure script.**
   - **Measure script** (`scripts/lin-4200-measure-records-vs-snapshots.mjs:559`): pass `requestSource: NO_REQUEST_RECORDS` with the scoped `urlKey` (the loop variable from `:555`), and `await` it, since `lineages.map` follows at `:566`.
     - `main()` is never reached by a unit test (it needs `MONGODB_URI`, `:540`), and LIN-4203's acceptance re-runs this script live.
     - So either run it once against a local mongod before the PR, or move the snapshot-side read into a tested export.
   - **`scripts/lin3014/capture-kpis.mjs:65`:** pass only `requestSource: NO_REQUEST_RECORDS`. `collectKpiStats` passes `instanceWide` itself.
   - **`scripts/lin-4200-d13-volume-timing.mjs:300`:** pass `requestSource: loader`.
4. **The LIN-4203 overlap is wider than section 8 says.** Its branch `origin/feat/lin-4203-stop-usage-snapshots` (`ec3b4800`) also touches files this plan edits:
   - `lib/cost-read.js:105-110` (a LEGACY comment above `usageStateOf`);
   - `server.js:42,457` (the `usageSnapshotCollection` wiring);
   - `docs/architecture/source-map.md` at about `:146-151`.
   - Each hunk is in a different region from this plan's edits (`cost-read.js` entries, `server.js:2506`, `source-map.md:141,190`), so a rebase would be mechanical.
   - **Do:** widen section 8's `git log origin/main -- …` check to `lib/cost-read.js server.js docs/architecture/source-map.md`, alongside the three files it names.
5. **The four `renderSessionPage` test files need a `runView` fixture, not a swap to a pure core.** Today they wrap with `withRequestRows(renderSessionPage, 1, { requestRows: [] })`:
   - `tests/unit/render-session.test.js:6` (130 calls);
   - `tests/unit/loop-supersede.test.js:7`;
   - `tests/unit/render-session-golden.test.js:25`;
   - `tests/unit/lin-3254-run-proposals-apply.test.js:28`.
   - **Do:** once `runView` is required, swap each for a small fixture that builds `runView` into argument 0 from its `session` via the pure core, with no records. The golden HTML should stay byte-identical.
6. **Put the scope decision's clause in the Done-when.** The 11:15Z scope decision (LIN-4201 description, item 2) says "each passes a cost source (the loader) to the read once … The next input to the read should then touch no caller". The plan's design delivers this: callers pass the loader through unchanged, from the one `requestUsageLoader(...)` built in `server.js`. But the Done-when drops the clause.
   - **Do:** add "a new required input to the read changes no caller file" to the Done-when, and name the extension point. A new input is a method on the source, added in `lib/request-usage-loader.js` and built in `server.js`, so callers stay unchanged.
   - Identity rows staying loaded by callers is the state LIN-4201 accepted (item 3 kept the query on the store), so it isn't in scope here.
7. **One stale doc line to fix in the docs step.** In `docs/architecture/source-map.md`, the `request-usage-store.js` entry still ends "Callers: the two LIN-4200 measurement scripts; LIN-4201's cost read is next." Update it to name the loader as the store's caller, alongside the plan's `:141,190` edits.

Next step: `implementation`, with these notes.

## Review — LIN-4226

PR https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2275, reviewed at head `453710d0e14c10e462c521f5c5b2495c771555d7`, based on `origin/main` `d7ceb373` (LIN-4203, #2274).

CI: green on head `453710d0`: Unit tests, E2E shards 1–4, Secret scan (source), CI success (run https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/actions/runs/41890394241). CI exists, so the two-branch substitute does not apply.

### What was checked

- **Staleness and regressions.** Since the ticket was filed, the in-scope paths were touched only by `2ee4e600` (LIN-4201, the plan's baseline) and `d7ceb373` (LIN-4203). LIN-4203's hunks survive the rebase: the LEGACY comment at `lib/cost-read.js:109` and the snapshot-collection wiring at `server.js:461`. LIN-4212's read-by-posting-row still holds, because the read goes through the loader and never the store. The loader's `appendAll` stack-overflow fix and its 500-anchor batching are unchanged. Nothing reverted earlier is re-applied.
- **Gap analysis against the ticket's constraints and the plan-review notes.** All are met in code:
  - Callers pass `requestSource` (or the injected loader). No production `requestRows` remains, and no caller loads records itself.
  - A missing source throws a named `TypeError` (`lib/cost-read.js:142`, `lib/run-view.js:388`, `lib/kpi-stats.js:1066`). The old `requestRows` key also throws (`Object.hasOwn`).
  - A read needs `urlKey` or `instanceWide: true`. `/kpis` is the only `instanceWide` caller and makes one batched load (`lib/kpi-stats.js:1087`).
  - Identity and records load in parallel (`Promise.all` at `lib/cost-read.js:313`, with identity accepted as a promise).
  - `renderSessionPage` requires `runView`.
  - No production code imports a `*OverRecords` core. `NO_REQUEST_RECORDS` is named, and `[]` is never a silent fallback. Loader batching is untouched.
  - `tests/fixtures/cost-replay/lin4201-change-list.json` and `tests/unit/lin-4201-replay-change-list.test.js` are byte-unchanged.
  - Plan-review notes 1–7 are all addressed.
  - On the three recorded deviations:
    - Refusing both `urlKey` and `instanceWide` is a sound tightening.
